environment.runtime_mode: one isolated Gazebo and MoveIt GetMotionPlan graph per runtime case

reachable_generator.derivation: Apply the pinned shoulder_pan transform to the cube and all Candidate024 arm positions and orientations, preserving target-to-gripper geometry.

method_correction.old_method: Rigid XYZ translation around the base_link origin while keeping full orientation fixed.
method_correction.old_result: 10/10 proposed positive cases failed first-stage IK; the unchanged Candidate024 control passed all three segments.
method_correction.root_cause: The shoulder_pan joint is offset from the base origin and its local +Z maps to base-frame -Z. The old transform therefore did not follow the robot's FK manifold.
method_correction.corrected_result: Using the pinned joint origin and axis produced 10/10 distinct positive plan-only passes.

claim_boundary: This is repeatable configuration, scene-contract, IK and MoveIt trajectory-validation evidence for twenty distinct target cases.
Each positive target was run once in this matrix; the earlier fixed Candidate024 control, not each distinct target, has a ten-attempt repeatability result.
All trajectories were discarded and no ExecuteTrajectory or FollowJointTrajectory goal was sent.
This is not execution, contact, lift, retention, physics-grasp, real-camera, or hardware evidence.
